content: The customer, Neha Chauhan, called to inquire about her expired health policy (HP-001234). The agent, Karan Joshi, informed her that the policy expired on the 10th of the month and explained that renewals now include a 5% premium increase ($150 per month) due to newly added mental health coverage and increased outpatient limits. After reviewing the details, the customer agreed to proceed, and the agent stated he would send a renewal form for her to sign and return.

action_items: Agent to send renewal form to the customer
Customer to sign and return the renewal form
